$comment: Machine-readable rights ledger for the tabletop systems issue #200 names as design influences on the NooPunk rules kernel. Purpose: record, per source, what its license actually is, what may be reused, and what may not -- BEFORE any rule text is ported into a Creative Commons NooPunk. Companion to data/sources/external_sources.json (issue #60), which covers the Eclipse Phase reference set; this file covers the Fudge/Fate/PbtA/OSR set plus the closed systems #200 removes. This file records LICENSE FINDINGS ONLY. No rule text, table, formula or artwork from any source here has been imported. Every 'license_checked' date is a real-world observation date, not in-world canon.
$retrieved_convention: Real-world metadata dates. AGENTS.md section 6 limits in-world future dates to 20XX; this file makes no in-world claims.

author_direction.decision: NooPunk will be fully Creative Commons (author decision, 2026-10-10).
author_direction.supersedes: Earlier #200 language treating Cyberpunk RED as the mechanics baseline, and any implication that OGL material can simply be relicensed CC.
author_direction.design_geometry: Equilateral GNS triangle: Simulationism ~33.33% (Eclipse Phase), Narrativism ~33.33% (Apocalypse World / The Veil), Gamism ~33.33% (Cities Without Number / Stars Without Number). Proportions are playtest goals, not page quotas. No influence is ranked above another.
author_direction.center: One NooPunk system homebrewed from Fudge + Psi-Punk + Fate + Transhumanity's Fate together. Separate Attributes and Skills (Fudge's distinction) are NOT optional; the six STATs FIT/REF/INT/SOC/CYB/PSY and the existing Skill catalogue survive.
author_direction.not_yet_done: This issue is a specification. No code or rulebook text has migrated merely because this ledger exists.

target_license.$comment: Itemized: the rulebook/setting and the code are licensed separately, and the choice is the author's.

rulebook_and_original_setting.why: Permits commercial and non-commercial modification, requires attribution and reciprocity, and accepts adaptation of CC BY 3.0 and CC BY-SA 3.0 material -- which is exactly the Fate Core SRD (BY 3.0) and The Veil (BY-SA 3.0) pathway.
rulebook_and_original_setting.alternative_cost: Maximum permissive reuse, but then CC BY-SA expression (e.g. The Veil) must NOT be directly adapted.

code.license: separate software license (MIT, Apache-2.0 or GPL)
code.why: A CC license is not a software license; source code must be licensed and attributed separately.

target_license.status: RECOMMENDED, NOT RATIFIED -- requires explicit author selection before any porting.

decision_vocabulary.verified-permissive: License read directly at the authoritative source. Adaptation is permitted with attribution; the source is compatible with a commercially reusable CC release.
decision_vocabulary.verified-public-domain: A verified CC0 / public-domain dedication. No attribution obligation, but verify the SCOPE -- an SRD is not the full commercial book.
decision_vocabulary.verified-nc-sharealike: Verified NonCommercial + ShareAlike. Its expression CANNOT enter a commercially reusable CC BY or BY-SA release. Independent implementation of described ideas only.
decision_vocabulary.no-cc-grant-established: No Creative Commons grant found. This is not a finding that reuse is forbidden; it is a finding that reuse of expression is NOT permitted on this evidence. Implement concepts independently, copy nothing.
decision_vocabulary.blocked-unverified: The authoritative page could not be read. Recorded as a blocked verification, NOT as a negative result: nothing may be asserted about the terms either way, and nothing may be imported.
decision_vocabulary.proprietary-out-of-scope: Closed/proprietary rules. Must not remain a base, an implementation source, or an attribution/reuse dependency for NooPunk rules. Abstract design lessons and genre/interaction references are permitted; no text, tables, formulas, code, assets or worlds.

sources.source: Cities Without Number System Reference Document (Kevin Crawford / Sine Nomine)
sources.role_in_noopunk: Gamist influence: fast procedures, generators, mission structure, encounter pacing, cyberpunk skill framing.
sources.how_verified: Two independent readings. (1) The publisher blurb, as carried by the SRD's storefront listings, states the document 'is provided under a Creative Commons 0 waiver allowing downloaders to copy, modify, reproduce'. (2) The SRD mirror site states 'The SRD is a free, open-source, and public domain document'. The gordianblade viewer renders client-side, so its own licence text could not be read as static HTML -- hence the storefront blurb is the load-bearing evidence.
sources.notes: SCOPE MATTERS: the CC0 dedication covers the SYSTEM REFERENCE DOCUMENT. It is not a finding that the full commercial Cities Without Number book is CC0. Use only the SRD, and only the parts it actually covers.

reuse_rules.$comment: The gates that make this ledger enforceable rather than decorative.
reuse_rules.cc0: Usable in any NooPunk release, commercial or not. Scope-limited: an SRD dedication does not cover its full commercial book.
reuse_rules.cc_by_3_0: Adaptable with attribution. One-way compatible into a CC BY-SA 4.0 work.
reuse_rules.cc_by_sa_3_0: Adaptable with attribution, ShareAlike. Compatible with a CC BY-SA 4.0 release only, not with CC BY-only.
reuse_rules.cc_by_nc_sa: NOT usable in a commercially reusable CC BY or BY-SA release. Independent implementation of described ideas only.
reuse_rules.ogl_1_0a: NOT a CC grant and not relabellable as CC. Obligations are incompatible with a pure CC release. Design inspiration only absent separate written permission.
reuse_rules.proprietary: No copying of any kind. Abstract design lessons and genre references only.
reuse_rules.public_availability_is_not_a_license: Being downloadable, having an SRD, appearing on GitHub, or being free does not equal a Creative Commons grant.
reuse_rules.amount_recycled: How much was reused matters for identifying an adaptation, but small changes do not remove a licence restriction.
reuse_rules.ideas_vs_expression: Implementing a described game procedure is not copying the expression of it. This distinction is the whole basis on which NooPunk may be CC while inspired by OGL and NC systems.

authority_conflict.$comment: HERMES.md: when a task conflicts with a locked element, preserve the lock and report the conflict.
authority_conflict.what: AGENTS.md section 13 (design balances) and section 15 (independent-system rule) are author-owned. Section 13.8 forbids silently redesigning the balances; section 13.9 and section 15.2 fix issue #111's 1-10 STAT + 1-10 Skill + 1d10 core as the active baseline; section 13.2 fixes the CY_BORG/Cyberpunk 2020/The Sprawl poles.
authority_conflict.why_it_blocks: Issue #200 supersedes the framing and replaces the poles, and its own text says to 'Update AGENTS.md/locked-rule policy by author-approved process'. It is not an agent decision.
authority_conflict.build_coupling: AGENTS.md section 13, docs/archive/DESIGN_PRINCIPLES.md and tests/test_design_principles.py are guarded as a set: the test fails the build if they drift out of agreement. Any change must move all three together, deliberately.
authority_conflict.agent_action: PRESERVED UNCHANGED. Reported to the author in the #200 thread. Not touched by this increment.
